c74object.name: el.latch~
c74object.digest: Impulse-triggered sample-and-hold latch with duration timeout
c74object.description:
el.latch~ captures an incoming non-zero click or impulse and holds its value continuously at the output for a specified duration in milliseconds, after which the output drops back to 0.0. If a new non-zero sample arrives while a latch is already active, the duration timer resets immediately and latches the new sample value. This enables sample-accurate generation of sustained gate signals from discrete click triggers (e.g., for driving envelope generators or note-on/note-off transitions).
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal): Non-zero trigger input. Any non-zero sample latches its amplitude to the output and begins the duration timer.
Inlet 2 [Right Inlet] (signal / float): Latch duration in milliseconds. Can be set via float/int messages or modulated continuously at audio rate.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Latched output signal. Emits the held amplitude value during the active latch window, and 0.0 when idle.

inlet.description: Monitored for non-zero audio samples. Any non-zero sample latches its value to the output and resets the duration timer.
Sets the latch duration in milliseconds (minimum 1.0 ms). Accepts float numbers or audio-rate signals.

outlet.description: Outputs the held sample value for the specified duration, then returns to 0.0.

objarg.name: latch-duration
objarg.description: The hold duration in milliseconds (default: 1000.0 ms, minimum: 1.0 ms).

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet 2 sets the latch duration in milliseconds.

method.name: int
method.description: Integer sent to inlet 2 sets the latch duration in milliseconds.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 provides trigger impulses. Signal arriving at inlet 2 continuously modulates the latch duration at audio rate.
